claim_summary: Global closed-form two-regime diagonal condition-number minimum in an m+1 dimensional hub-exchangeable Stieltjes family, including Jacobi iff couplings equal.
limitations: Two-coupling hub--exchangeable SPD Stieltjes class only, m >= 3
No unrestricted uniqueness assertion for optimizing diagonal congruences
The three-dimensional case is previously solved by Kolotilina; the new claim excludes it
Equivalent explicit all-size specialization may occur in unindexed literature or inaccessible historic papers
scientific_integrity: Proof uses global diagonal LMI averaging, explicit block spectrum and scalar monotonicity. Finite independent matrix computations are corroboration, not proof of infinity.
title: Sharp two-regime diagonal preconditioning for hub–exchangeable Stieltjes systems
